title: Drumfight Napoli 97
subtitle: Students by day, percussion warriors by night

authors.role: game design, programming, drum kit, pixel art
authors.name: Claude Code (Anthropic)

acknowledgements: To the drummers of Piazza San Domenico Maggiore, Naples, 1997.
The story and its characters are fiction; the piazza is real.
All sounds are synthesized by the PRG32 SID-like synthesizer: no samples, no recordings.
PRG32 framework; big-title glyph shapes from the PRG32-QT host font.
content_notice: A music game. No violence: battles are fought with rhythm.

controls.action: Erase under the playhead / wipe the last voice

start_prompt: Press A to enter the piazza
